findings.description: The condition uses all(...) where the docstring says "if at least one is documented"; it should be any(...). The section now shows only when every argument has help.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with two arguments where only one has help. all() returns False, so the whole Positional arguments section is omitted and the documented argument disappears from the help output. Conversely, a command with no arguments makes all([]) True, so an empty "Positional arguments" section header is emitted with no entries.
